title: 국방정보본부령 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00005:part:1/1

Article 4 (Establishment of Divisions and Units)
(1) Staff divisions necessary for the Intelligence Headquarters shall be established therein, and matters concerning their organization and allocation of duties shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense.
(2) The following subordinate units shall be established under the Intelligence Headquarters: [Amended on December 30, 2009; July 1, 2011; December 4, 2018; and April 7, 2026.]
1. The Intelligence Command, to take charge of collecting, supporting and researching military-related geospatial information, human intelligence, technical intelligence, measurement and signature intelligence, etc. (hereinafter referred to as "geospatial information, etc."), and of counterintelligence as defensive measures against enemy collection of geospatial information, etc.;
2. The 777 Command, to take charge of collecting, supporting and researching various types of signals intelligence;
3. Deleted on December 4, 2018.
(3) Matters concerning the organization and allocation of duties of the units referred to in the subparagraphs of paragraph (2) shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense. [Newly inserted on December 30, 2009.]
